authPolicy: existing auth.json opencode-go entry (model opencode/big-pickle). OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY from acp-poc.env as fallback.
sessionPersistencePolicy: resume/load advertised AND succeed after process restart (verified 2026-09-15). Still record reason + old/new IDs on recreate.
